His next submission is that section 7 of the Act by providing special procedure for appeal simply decrecte the scope of order 41 and section 94 of the civil procedure code. His final argument is that section 6 of the Act provides that the proceeding, Order, Judgment and decree of Artha Rin Adalat shall not be called in question before any court or authority same as provided by section 7 of the Act and as such section 6 prohibits revision to the High Court Division.
